problems.problem: The top text band is set in plain Arial with modest sizes (title 58px, subtitle 22px), while references 3-5 all use elegant high-contrast serif or refined letter-spaced faces; against the luxury lacquer concept the type reads generic and under-scaled, and the subtitle's optical center sits left of the title/logo axis, loosening the stacked band.

The generated backdrop reads as matte painted wood planks with hard vertical groove seams running the full canvas height, including directly behind the bottle and through the contact zone; the declared concept is a polished lacquer panel with soft vertical gradient and sheen, so the seam grid interferes with the hero and contradicts the glossy material story.

The contact detail crop confirms a real soft contact shadow hugging the base at offset_y 0 (correct, not floating), but because the backdrop shows no horizontal support plane or tonal floor transition, the shadowed base reads as resting on an invisible ledge in front of a vertical plank wall; the lighting on the bottle (bright frontal studio key) is not echoed by any gradient or sheen pool in the background.

The剧院-style top band ends at the gold rule (y≈288) leaving a ~245px empty gap before the cap at y=533, while the bottle base stops at y=1253 with ~187px below; the middle void weakens the vertical rhythm versus references where type, object and negative space interlock, and the decoration rule floats disconnected between subtitle and bottle.

References achieve material drama (glossy red field, mirrored brass table, smoldering wood and water) and rich retouching; this draft keeps a flat evenly-lit plank field and a small isolated bottle with no supporting light event, so the design-quality gap remains despite clean layout.

changes.value: Seamless deep teal lacquer surface, mirror-polished vertical panel with soft top-to-bottom light gradient, faint glossy sheen streaks and a subtle horizontal reflective plane low in frame, even broad frontal illumination, no seams, no planks, no objects
